name: player solo tackles year and week axes
description: The defensive UNION subquery projects every row axis that resolves to it. Before, a week axis emitted defensive_plays.week against a subquery that only projected year and nfl_week_id (42703).
expected_query:
with "base_years" as (SELECT unnest(ARRAY[2023]) as year), "player_years" as (SELECT DISTINCT player.pid, base_years.year FROM player CROSS JOIN base_years), "player_years_weeks" as (SELECT player_years.pid, nfl_year_week_timestamp.year, nfl_year_week_timestamp.week FROM player_years INNER JOIN nfl_year_week_timestamp ON player_years.year = nfl_year_week_timestamp.year WHERE nfl_year_week_timestamp.year = 2023), "td55ff66e09d9755abc5cf440702caeea" as materialized (select defensive_plays.pid, SUM(CASE WHEN pid_column = 'solo_tackle_1_pid' THEN 1 WHEN pid_column = 'solo_tackle_2_pid' THEN 1 WHEN pid_column = 'solo_tackle_3_pid' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS solo_tackles_from_plays, "defensive_plays"."week", "defensive_plays"."year" from (select solo_tackle_1_pid as pid, 'solo_tackle_1_pid' as pid_column, play_type, season_type as seas_type, season_year as year, nfl_week_id, week from "nfl_plays" where "solo_tackle_1_pid" is not null and "nfl_plays"."season_year" in (2023) union all select solo_tackle_2_pid as pid, 'solo_tackle_2_pid' as pid_column, play_type, season_type as seas_type, season_year as year, nfl_week_id, week from "nfl_plays" where "solo_tackle_2_pid" is not null and "nfl_plays"."season_year" in (2023) union all select solo_tackle_3_pid as pid, 'solo_tackle_3_pid' as pid_column, play_type, season_type as seas_type, season_year as year, nfl_week_id, week from "nfl_plays" where "solo_tackle_3_pid" is not null and "nfl_plays"."season_year" in (2023)) as "defensive_plays" where "play_type" in ('PASS', 'RUSH', 'CONV', 'KOFF', 'PUNT', 'FGXP', 'FREE') and "defensive_plays"."seas_type" in ('REG') and "defensive_plays"."year" in (2023) group by "defensive_plays"."week", "defensive_plays"."year", "defensive_plays"."pid"), "player_participation_weeks" as (SELECT pid, year, week, bool_or(is_active) AS is_active
          FROM (SELECT pgl.pid, 2023::int AS year, g.week, pgl.is_active
       FROM player_gamelogs_year_2023 pgl
       INNER JOIN nfl_games g ON g.esbid = pgl.esbid
       WHERE g.season_type = 'REG' AND g.season_year = 2023) src
          GROUP BY pid, year, week), "player_years_teams" as (SELECT pid, year, array_agg(DISTINCT team_code) AS teams
          FROM (SELECT pgl.pid, 2023::int AS year, pgl.nfl_team AS team_code
       FROM player_gamelogs_year_2023 pgl
       INNER JOIN nfl_games g ON g.esbid = pgl.esbid
       WHERE g.season_type = 'REG' AND g.season_year = 2023) src
          GROUP BY pid, year), "team_weeks_played" as (select distinct "team", "year", "week" from ((select "home_nfl_team" as "team", "season_year" as "year", "week" from "nfl_games" where "nfl_games"."season_type" in ('REG') and "nfl_games"."season_year" in (2023)) union all (select "away_nfl_team" as "team", "season_year" as "year", "week" from "nfl_games" where "nfl_games"."season_type" in ('REG') and "nfl_games"."season_year" in (2023))) as "g") select "player"."pid", player.first_name, player.last_name, "td55ff66e09d9755abc5cf440702caeea"."solo_tackles_from_plays" AS "solo_tackles_from_plays_0", "player_years_weeks"."year", "player_years_weeks"."week", CASE
     WHEN player_participation_weeks.is_active THEN 'active'
     WHEN player_participation_weeks.pid IS NULL
          AND player_years_teams.teams IS NOT NULL
          AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM team_weeks_played
            WHERE team_weeks_played.year = player_years_weeks.year
              AND team_weeks_played.week = player_years_weeks.week
              AND team_weeks_played.team = ANY(player_years_teams.teams)
          )
       THEN 'bye'
     ELSE NULL
   END AS participation_status, "player"."primary_position" from "player" inner join "player_years_weeks" on "player_years_weeks"."pid" = "player"."pid" left join "td55ff66e09d9755abc5cf440702caeea" on "td55ff66e09d9755abc5cf440702caeea"."pid" = "player"."pid" and "td55ff66e09d9755abc5cf440702caeea"."year" = 2023 and td55ff66e09d9755abc5cf440702caeea.week = player_years_weeks.week left join "player_participation_weeks" on "player_participation_weeks"."pid" = "player"."pid" and "player_participation_weeks"."year" = "player_years_weeks"."year" and "player_participation_weeks"."week" = "player_years_weeks"."week" left join "player_years_teams" on "player_years_teams"."pid" = "player"."pid" and "player_years_teams"."year" = "player_years_weeks"."year" group by player.first_name, player.last_name, "td55ff66e09d9755abc5cf440702caeea"."solo_tackles_from_plays", "player_years_weeks"."year", "player_years_weeks"."week", CASE
     WHEN player_participation_weeks.is_active THEN 'active'
     WHEN player_participation_weeks.pid IS NULL
          AND player_years_teams.teams IS NOT NULL
          AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM team_weeks_played
            WHERE team_weeks_played.year = player_years_weeks.year
              AND team_weeks_played.week = player_years_weeks.week
              AND team_weeks_played.team = ANY(player_years_teams.teams)
          )
       THEN 'bye'
     ELSE NULL
   END, "player"."pid", "player"."last_name", "player"."first_name", "player"."primary_position" order by "player"."pid" asc limit 500
